## Summary

Describe the exact functional or documentation change.

## Version and artifacts

- [ ] Test/release version is unique.
- [ ] Exact BASIC source accompanies the PRG.
- [ ] D64 contains the intended PRG.
- [ ] SHA-256 checksums are included and verified.
- [ ] No commercial/private ROM images are included.

## Compatibility

- [ ] OneROM firmware version recorded.
- [ ] OneROM CLI/plugin requirements recorded.
- [ ] Every multi-chip friendly label is on `chips[0]`.

## Hardware testing

- [ ] Device 8 tested.
- [ ] Device 9 tested.
- [ ] Upper-socket configuration tested or marked not tested.
- [ ] Lower-socket configuration tested or marked not tested.
- [ ] QUIT leaves NV data unchanged and drive responsive.
- [ ] SAVE persists the selection after power cycle.
- [ ] Any hang/recovery behavior is documented.

## Release protection

- [ ] Stable v1.1.0 artifacts were not changed without a new release version.
- [ ] Layout/colors and existing behavior changed only as documented.
